name: Granola
tagline: AI notepad that enriches your own meeting notes.
best_for: People in back-to-back meetings who want notes without a visible bot
description:
Granola is an AI notepad aimed at meetings. You jot down rough notes while you talk, and the tool combines them with a transcript of the conversation to produce a structured, readable set of notes afterwards.

The approach keeps you in control of what matters, since your own typed points guide the final summary. It suits consultants, founders and managers who sit in many calls and want searchable records. Always tell participants when a call is being transcribed and review the output for errors. Platform support and plans change, so check the official site for current details.
use_steps: Install the app and sign in.
Open it at the start of a meeting.
Type short notes as the discussion goes on.
Review and edit the enhanced notes afterwards.
pros: Notes guided by your own jottings

name: Fathom
tagline: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes calls.
best_for: Teams that want automatic call summaries and action items
description:
Fathom is an AI meeting assistant that joins video calls to record, transcribe and summarize them. After a call it produces a summary, highlights and action items you can review and share.

It fits sales, customer success and project teams who want a record of what was agreed without writing minutes by hand. Recording laws and company policies differ, so get consent and review summaries before sharing them.
